व्राचट or व्राचड m. a kind of Apabhraṃśa dialect, Cat.
1. व्राज m. (for 2. See below) going, movement, motion, MW.

a domestic cock, L.

व्राजम् (अम्), ind., in troops
व्राज—पति (or व्राज-प्˚) m. the lord of a troop or host, RV.; AV.

a: व्राजिः — f. A gust or gale of wind, stormy wind.

व्राजिन् See विष्ठा-व्राजिन्, p. 999, col. 1.

a: व्रातीन — a. 1 Living by day-labour, a hired labourer, coolie. --2 One living by violence.

m: व्रात &c. See below.

व्रात m. (connected with √ 1. वृ, or with व्रत and √ 2. वृ) a multitude, flock, assemblage, troop, swarm, group, host (व्रातं व्रातम्, in companies or troops; पञ्च व्रातास्, the five races of men), association, guild, RV. &c. &c.
the company or attendants at a marriage feast, W.
= मनुष्य, Naigh. ii, 3
the descendant of an out-caste Brāhman &c. (= व्रात्य), L.
व्रात n. manual or bodily labour, day-labour, ib.
a: व्रातः — A multitude, group, flock, an assemblage; श्वपाकानां व्रातैः G. L. 29; R. 12. 94; Śi. 4. 35. --तं 1 Bodily or manual labour. --2 Daylabour. --3 Casual employment. --4 The company or attendants at a marriage feast.

व्रात—जीवन mfn. living by manual or bodily labour, MW.
व्रात—मय mf(ई)n. consisting of a multitude of (comp.), BhP.
व्रात—प˚तीय mfn. id., KātyŚr., Sch.
व्रात—पत mf(ई)n. relating or belonging or sacred to Vrata-pati, ŚrS.; Vas.
व्रात—प˚तेष्टि-प्रयोग m. N. of wk.
व्रात—पति (व्रात-), m. lord of an assemblage or association, VS.
व्रात—साह (Padap. -सह) mfn. conquering hosts or in hosts, RV.
व्रातिक n. a partic. observance, Gobh.
व्रात्या (आ), f. a female Vrātya, Mn. viii, 373
a vagrant life, PañcavBr.

s: puM, (vrAto vyAlAdiH sa iva । “SAKAdiByo yat .” 5 । 3 । 103 । iti yat .) daSasaMskArarahitaH । zoqaSavarzAdUrdDvaM akftavratabanDo BrazwagAyattrIko vA । iti BarataH ॥ tatparyyAyaH । saMskArahInaH 2 । ityamaraH ॥ sAvitrIpatitaH 3 vAgduzwaH 4 puruzoktikaH 5 । iti jawADaraH ॥ tasya prAyaScittAdi yaTA, -- “aTa vrAtyaviDiM devi ! prAyaScittantu yadBavet । tat SfRuzva maheSAni sarvvavarRe viSezataH ॥ daSa varzARi paYcEva brAhmaRaScopanIyate । ekaviMSativarzARi yAvadvarzamupAvaSet । ata UrdDvaM patanneva sarvvaDarmmabahizkftaH ॥ gAyattrIpatitA vrAtyA vrAtyastomena saMskftaH । aSakte cEva yajYasya caredOddAnikaM vratam ॥ dvO mAsO yAvakAhAro mAsamekaM payaH pibet । daDnA ca pakzamekantu saptarAtraM Gftena tu ॥ ayAcitena zaqrAtraM trirAtraM barttayejjalEH । ahorAtraM na BuYjIta tataH saMskAramarhati ॥ patitA yasya gAyattrI daSa varzARi paYca ca । prAyaScittaM Bavettasya provAca BagavAn SivaH ॥ saSiKaM vapanaM kftvA vrataM kuryyAt samAhitaH । havizyaM BojayedannaM brAhmaRAn sapta paYca vA ॥ ekaviMSatirAtrantu pibet prasftiyAvakam । tato yAvakaSudDasya tasyopanayanaM smftam ॥ vratasyAcaraRASaktO kuryyAccAndrAyaRatrayam । sAvitrIpatitA yezAM deSakAlAdiviplavAt ॥ cAndrAyaRaM caredyastu vratAnte Denumutsfjet । kzIraMvApi pibenmAsaM dadyAdgAM vatsaSAlinIm ॥” iti matsyasUkte prAyaScittaprakaraRe 38 pawalaH ॥
v: pu॰ vrAtAt samUhAt cyavati yat । avyavahAryye, saMskArahIne, jAtimAtropajIvini, “ata UrdDvaM trayo'pyete yaTAkAlamasaMskftAH । sAvitrIpratitA krAtyA BavantyAryyavigarhitAH” manuH । tatra prAyaScittaM mitA॰ uktaM yaTA tatra vrAtyatAyAM manunedamuktam “yezAM dvijAnAM sAvitrI nAnUcyeta yaTAviDi । tAMScArayitvA trIn kfcCrAn yaTAviDyupanAyayediti” । yacca yamenoktam “sAvitrIpatitA yasya daSa varzARi paYca ca । saSiKaM vapanaM kftvA vrataM kuryyAt samAhitaH । ekaviMSatirAtraYca pibet prasftiyAvakam । habizA BojayeccEva brAhmaRAn sapta paYca vA । tato yAvakaSudDasya tasyopanayanaM smftam” iti । taduBayamapi yAjYavalkIyamAsapayovratavizayam । yattu vaSizWenoktam “patitasAvitrIka uddAlakavrataYcaret । dvO mAsO yAvakena varttayenyAsaM payasA pakzamAmikzayAzwarAtraM Gftena zaqrAtramayAcitena trirAtrasabsakzo'horAtrasupavasedaSvameDAvaBfTaNgacCedvAtyastomena vA yajeteti” । tatreyaM vyavasTA yasyopanayane ApadBAvena tatkAlAtikramastasya yAjYavalkIyavratAnAmanyatamat SaktyapekzayA Bavati anApadyatikrame tu mAnavaM trEmAsikam । tatrEva paYcadaSavarzAdUrdDamapi kiyatkAlAtikrame tUddAlakavratam brAtyastomo veti । yezAntu pitrAdayo'pyanupanItAstezAmApastamboktam “yasya pitA pitAmahAvanupanItO syAtAntasya saMvatsaraM trEvidyakaM brahmacaryyam । yasya prapitAmahAdernAnusmaryate upanayanantasya dvAdaSa varzARi trEvidyakaM brahmacaryyamiti” ।
m: व्रात्य m. a man of the mendicant or vagrant class, a tramp, out-caste, low or vile person (either a man who has lost caste through non-observance of the ten principal Saṃskāras, or a man of a partic. low caste descended from a Śūdra and a Kṣatriyā; accord. to some ‘the illegitimate son of a Kṣatriya who knows the habits and intentions of soldiers’; in AV. xv, 8, 1; 9, 1, the Rājanyas and even the Brāhmans are said to have sprung from the Vrātya who is identified with the Supreme Being, prob. in glorification of religious mendicancy; accord. to ĀpŚr. व्रात्य is used in addressing a guest), AV. &c. &c.
व्रात्य mfn. belonging to the Vrata called Mahā-vrata (q.v.), PañcavBr., Sch.
a: व्रात्यः — [व्रातात् समूहात च्यवति यत्] 1 A man of the first three classes who has lost his caste owing to the non-performance of the principal Saṃskāras or purificatory rites (especially investiture with the sacred thread) over him, an outcast; भवत्या हि व्र त्याधमपतितपाखंडपरिषत्परित्राणस्नेहः G. L. 37. --2 A low or vile person in general. --3 A man of a particular inferior tribe (the descendant of a Śūdra father and Kṣatriya mother). --त्या The daughter of an outcast. --Comp. --ब्रुवः one who calls himself a Vrātya. --स्तोमः N. of a sacrifice performed to rec over the rights forfeited by the non-performance of the due Saṃskāras.

k.v: नष्टाग्निः कुहना लोभान्मिथ्येर्यापथकल्पना। व्रात्यः संस्कारहीनः स्यादस्वाध्यायो निराकृतिः॥

m: व्रात्य—स्तोम m. N. of partic. Ekāhas, ŚrS.; Gaut.; Vas.

व्रात्य—यज्ञ m. a kind of sacrifice, PañcavBr. (cf. -स्तोम).
